description: Panels needed to offset annual electricity use, from panel wattage, peak sun hours and system losses. Formula: Annual kWh per panel = W/1000 × peak sun hours × 365 × (1 − losses). Panels = ⌈annual use ÷ kWh per panel⌉.

peak_sun_hours.description: Peak sun hours/day (look up in PVWatts) (h); default 5
